claim: What's your traditional Thanksgiving menu? : r/Cooking - Reddit
summary: It's different depending on who's hosting. Usually we have sweet and unsweet tea, wine, Turkey or Roast Chicken, sliced ham by the rolls, sweet potato bake with marshmallows, mashed potatoes, green beans ( casserole or blanched with almonds), butter beans with corn and tomatoes, cranberry sauce, brown gravy, stuffing/ dressing, deviled eggs, pickles, pickled beets, collards, sometimes baked ...
